description: Zero-shot voice cloning: needs a reference clip on the speaker, ideally with its transcript. Natural, stable narration. Apache 2.0 license.
cpuNote: Works on the CPU, but slowly.

settings.label: Reference transcript
settings.description: The exact words spoken in the reference clip. Strongly recommended: without it the voice match is weaker.

settings.label: Instruction
settings.description: How to say it, e.g. "Speak slowly and sadly." or a dialect. Uses the clip's voice but not its transcript. Leave empty for plain cloning.
